inputs.original_text: The split comes as some MPs raise the prospect of a new conversation about the party’s leadership Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, exposing a clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival. The opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text:
Listen to what is being passed along here, because people need to open their eyes to this. They want everyone to believe it is just a normal political disagreement, but it is actually all theater designed to distract us from the real puppet masters pulling the strings behind the scenes. 

Look at what is actually happening in plain sight: Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors. This isn't a mere clash of philosophies—it's a scripted diversion. They stage these internal feuds to create the illusion of debate while the elite consensus remains entirely untouched. 

And notice what else is being managed here. The opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. Why the sudden silence? Because they are all taking orders from the exact same hidden global network, toeing the line on foreign conflicts while pretending to squabble over domestic tax policy. We should not fall for their official narrative.
